actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger 1-2 inches down
Water thoroughly until it drains from the bottom
If soil is hard to wet, soak pot in bowl of water for 15-20 minutes
Empty the decorative cat pot of standing water after draining
Monitor recovery and recheck for dry soil or other problems if it doesn't perk up
Check soil every few days and water when top inch is dry
Move plant away from heat vents and radiators
Group with other plants or set up a pebble tray for humidity

reason: The answer names underwatering as the main cause, and its core advice (thorough watering and soaking) matches the bottom-watering fix, with no harmful suggestions.
